recipe.visualDefinition: A central, symmetrical composition featuring a crowned woman seated on an elaborate, fan-like golden throne made of curved metal strips. She wears a lavender-grey silk gown with one breast exposed, holding an infant wrapped in a beige cloth. The scene is set against deep red velvet curtains with two lit candles on ornate stands flanking the throne.
coreVisualRelationships: The golden throne acts as a halo-like radiating frame for the central figures.
Contrast between the cold, metallic throne and the soft, organic skin tones of the mother and child.
The deep red background provides a warm, saturated stage that pushes the cooler lavender dress forward.
Symmetrical balance anchored by the vertical axis of the woman's torso.
coreInvariants: Exposed breast as a symbol of nurturing power

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-body seated portrait occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the exposed breast, forming a vertical line of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the crown, follows the radiating gold strips outward, then curves back down to the infant and the flowing silk of the dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture and color, with small pockets of dark red shadow between the throne strips.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and golds, contrasted with the desaturated, mid-value silk of the gown and natural skin tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail cinematic photo of a woman with long dark hair wearing a crown and a lavender silk gown, seated on a throne made of radiating gold metal loops. She is holding a baby. The background is heavy red velvet curtains. Two lit candles on tall brass stands are on either side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a high-contrast, thin-serif typeface centered at the bottom or top, ensuring it does not overlap the central figures.

verificationChecks: Throne must have a fan-like radiating structure
Lighting must mimic candlelight with warm highlights
The dress texture must appear as heavy silk or satin
The background must be dark red velvet

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the throne strips look like solid metal, not ribbons.
Check that the candle flames look natural and provide a secondary light source.
Verify the silk dress has realistic folds and sheen.
Confirm the central symmetry is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Renaissance Madonna iconography + Modern Industrial Throne + Baroque Color Palette
